policy.name: Haryana Progressive MSME & Export Promotion Policy 2026
policy.order_no: Industries & Commerce Dept Notification No. 02/04/2026-1IB-II (Haryana Govt Gazette Extraordinary No. 114-2026/Ext.)

zones.prime: Prime/Focus Areas: areas within boundary of Industrial Investment Promotion Zones notified by Dept of Industries & Commerce
zones.sub_prime: Sub-Prime Areas: conforming industrial zones in Development Plans; vacant/unallotted plots in HSIIDC IMTs/estates and licensed private industrial parks/colonies; new industrial colony licences after notification; areas outside Controlled Area limits not in Prime
zones.intermediate: Intermediate Areas: allotted plots in HSIIDC IMTs/estates and licensed private industrial parks/colonies; areas between municipal limits and Controlled Area limits not in Prime/Sub-Prime
zones.core: Core Areas: within municipal limits, excluding Prime/Sub-Prime/Intermediate

zone_lookup: Definition 1(m) 'Categorisation of Areas' table, policy pages 11-12 (Gazette pp. 1921-1922). Municipal and Controlled Area limits as on date of promulgation; Prime/Focus = notified Industrial Investment Promotion Zones (separate DIC notification). No district list.

schemes.name: Haryana Udyam Vikas Mission - Capital Investment Subsidy for MSMEs & Exporters
schemes.clause: Para 4.1.1 and Table 3 (pp. 31, 37); Eligible Capital Expenditure defined at 1(i) p.10
schemes.notes: Only THRUST SECTOR manufacturing MSMEs/exporters (Def 1(n): auto/EV, aerospace & defence, general engg/metal, electrical/electronics, pharma/med devices, rubber & plastic, footwear/leather, renewable/circular/green, textile & apparel). New/expansion/diversification; expansion needs additional FCI >= 50% of existing FCI, once per policy period. ECE = building, P&M, equipment, utilities, ETP/waste/APC, hardware/software made before DoCP + 1 year after; excludes land, captive RE plants, ZLD, working capital, pre-operative. +5% extra for Women/SC/Divyang/Transgender/Ex-servicemen/Agniveer-owned thrust-sector MSMEs; +10% extra for existing exporting MSMEs doing expansion or JV with foreign investor. No double dipping. Overall cap on all incentives = 100% of FCI (para 3.6).
conditions: Thrust-sector manufacturing MSME as listed in the policy

schemes.name: Haryana Interest Subsidy Scheme
schemes.notes: Term loan for new/expansion/diversification projects of manufacturing MSEs (not medium). Rate varies by zone (top-level rate/annual_cap = Core values). Available only for 3 years after DoCP during policy period. +1% extra for Women/SC/Divyang/Transgender/Ex-servicemen/Agniveer-owned MSEs or JV with foreign investor. No total cap stated beyond annual cap.

schemes.name: Haryana Net SGST Reimbursement Subsidy for Intra-State Sales
schemes.clause: Para 4.1.3 and Table 3 (pp. 32, 37-38); Net SGST defined at 1(j) pp. 10-11
schemes.notes: IMPORTANT: rates are % OF NET SGST PAID (cash ledger, after using all ITC incl. IGST ITC) on intra-state sales, NOT a ceiling as % of FCI. rate_by_zone applies where >=50% of annual intra-state sales are B2C in Haryana; rate_by_zone_b2c_below_50pct where <50% B2C. B2B/B2C share certified annually by DETC. Manufacturing MSEs only. Only ceiling is overall 100% of FCI cap on all incentives (para 3.6). Aligned with Make in Haryana Industrial Policy 2026.

schemes.name: Assistance for Quality Certification
schemes.notes: Cap Rs 10 lakh PER YEAR for a period of 3 years, all MSEs; ISO, HACCP, BIS, WHO-GMP, ZED, TS, Hallmark or equivalent. Separately 4.3.5(II): MSE exporters 60% of country-specific international certification cost up to Rs 20 lakh/year for any two years.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Testing Equipment
schemes.notes: 50% subsidy up to Rs 25 lakh PER YEAR to all manufacturing MSEs for testing equipment.

schemes.name: Support for Solar Rooftops
schemes.notes: New and existing manufacturing MSMEs, rooftop solar with net metering.

schemes.name: Haryana MSME Automation Scheme
schemes.notes: Industrial automation for all manufacturing MSEs; operational guidelines to be notified.
conditions: Applies only to industrial automation spend; operational guidelines pending

schemes.name: Assistance for Environmental Compliance (ETP & ZLD)
schemes.notes: ETP: 25% of total cost (civil + machinery) up to Rs 1 crore in Sub-Prime & Prime/Focus Areas. ZLD: 25% up to Rs 5 crore in all areas (cost = actual or Rs 5 cr per MLD, whichever less).

other_benefits: Stamp duty refund: Core 30%, Intermediate 60%, Sub-Prime 75%, Prime/Focus 100% (4.2.3)
MSE insurance premium: 33% up to Rs 5 lakh/yr for 3 years (4.1.4)
ECGC export credit insurance premium: 40% up to Rs 5 lakh/yr for 5 years (4.1.5)
Interest subvention on export credit: 3% up to Rs 10 lakh/yr for 3 years for MSE exporters (4.1.6)
Freight subsidy for ZED-certified new MSE exporters: 1% of FOB or actual freight, cap Rs 10/15/30 lakh by area (4.2.4)
Mukhya Mantri Pratham Niryatak Protsahan Yojna: 33% up to Rs 20 lakh/yr for 3 yrs for first-time exporters (4.2.6)
R&D centre: 50% of project cost up to Rs 5 crore (4.3.2)
AI solutions/AI lab: 33% up to Rs 10 lakh / Rs 15 lakh once (4.3.4)
Energy efficiency / circular economy (RAMP): 25% up to Rs 50 lakh (Core/Intermediate), 40% up to Rs 1 crore (Sub-Prime/Prime) (4.5.1, 4.5.2)
E-commerce fees 75% up to Rs 2 lakh (exporters)/Rs 1 lakh (MSEs) per year; Market development 25% up to Rs 5 lakh intl/Rs 3 lakh domestic fair (4.4.1, 4.4.2)
Employment generation subsidy (salary-linked, up to Rs 1-1.2 lakh/employee/yr for 10 yrs) and EPF reimbursement via HKRN (4.6.1)
Cluster plug & play, CFC, PADMA parks grants (4.2.1, 4.2.2, 4.2.5)
Transitional clause 3.5: units that took effective steps and made substantial investment before 29-07-2026 may opt for HEEP 2020 incentives if DoCP is within 2 years of notification
